room_rent.note: Optional upgrade to Single Private AC Room (≤₹10,000/day) available for SI ≥₹5L at extra premium

icu.note: Optional Room Rent Upgradation cover changes ICU to actuals

copayment.display: None (base); 20% if Zone B insured treats in Zone A; voluntary 10%/20% for discount
copayment.note: Zone B policyholders pay 20% co-pay for treatment in Zone A cities (not applicable for accidental hospitalisation). Voluntary co-pay of 10% or 20% can be opted for premium discount.

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped (₹20k–₹40k per eye by SI slab)
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹20,000/eye for SI ≤₹1L; ₹30,000/eye for SI ₹1.5L–₹3L; ₹40,000/eye for SI ₹4L–₹10L

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible in base plan; deductible concept defined but not imposed by default

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered >12 months

ped_waiting.note: Reduced to extent of prior continuous coverage under portability

specific_disease_waiting.note: 12 mo: gastric ulcers, varicose veins, hydrocele, etc. 24 mo: cataract, hernia, sinuses, mental illness, etc. 36 mo: joint replacement, deviated nasal septum, gout, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: Base: 5% per claim-free year, max 25%. Optional Cumulative Bonus Enhancement add-on raises rate to 25%/yr, max 200% of SI.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional paid cover (SI ≥₹5L). Triggered only after full SI + CB exhausted; once per policy year; lifetime limit for cancer and kidney failure requiring dialysis; 15-day gap required for same insured.

pre_hosp.note: For same illness/injury as hospitalisation; inpatient claim must be admitted

post_hosp.note: For same illness/injury as hospitalisation; inpatient claim must be admitted

day_care.note: Indicative list of ~399 procedures in Annexure I; other <24hr procedures due to technology also covered

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is defined but no coverage section exists for it in operative parts

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (inpatient, govt/accredited hospitals)
ayush.note: Requires ≥24hr admission in government or accredited AYUSH hospital; room rent same cap as allopathy

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses covered; donor pre/post-hospitalisation excluded; must comply with Transplantation of Human Organs Act

ambulance.note: Also covers transfer between hospitals; payable only when life-threatening emergency certified and inpatient/day-care claim admitted

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed in Annexure III including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, etc.

consumables.note: Extensive non-medical/consumables exclusion list in Annexure II (gloves, diapers, ECG electrodes, etc.); no rider available

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded for all health covers; Personal Accident cover is worldwide but payment in India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud and permanent exclusions; resets on SI enhancement for enhanced portion

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/quarterly/half-yearly; 15 days for monthly instalment

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability/migration

portability.note: As per IRDAI portability guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, no maternity, no domiciliary, no OPD, no consumables, no infertility/IVF, no external appliances, no vaccination

optional_riders.display: Room Rent Upgrade (Single AC, ≥₹5L SI), CB Enhancement (25%/yr, max 200%), SI Reinstatement, Double SI for Cancer, Personal Accident
